## Summary

This is **dihydroxy-acid dehydratase (DHAD; EC 4.2.1.9)**. The sequence is an **exact match** to reviewed UniProt entry **A0L8Q3** from *Magnetococcus marinus*, so the identification is stronger than a family-level similarity inference.

DHAD catalyzes dehydration reactions in **branched-chain amino-acid biosynthesis**:

- **2,3-dihydroxyisovalerate → 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate (2-oxoisovalerate) + H₂O**, contributing to valine synthesis.
- **2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylvalerate → 3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate + H₂O**, contributing to isoleucine synthesis.

**Main characteristics:** the protein is 621 amino acids long, with a sequence-derived mass of about **66.3 kDa** and theoretical pI of **5.62**. Its annotation lists a **[2Fe–2S] cluster** (one per subunit; described as a Lewis-acid cofactor) and **Mg²⁺**. It is annotated as a **homodimer** and as **cytosolic**; the localization GO annotation is inferred.

These properties are sequence-derived estimates or database annotations, not measurements of the supplied protein sample.
